Take your first steps on the hunt. While you have an active treasure on the Map tab, the app records how far you move using GPS. Reach 10 metres of tracked walking to earn this badge.
Keep exploring campus with the map open. Your walk distance adds up across sessions as long as location updates are coming in. Hit 100 metres to show you are really covering ground.
The long-distance explorer badge. Five hundred metres of tracked movement means you have been out on foot around NTU for a serious stretch of the hunt.
Collect your first treasure from the map. Accept a clue on the Treasures screen, go to the Map when you are close enough, tap the pin, and confirm to add it to your collection.
Broaden your collection. Find three different treasures using the map and GPS check-in. Each rarity counts the same toward this total.
A committed collector. Five treasures found means you have completed several hunts end-to-end — clues, walking, and map pickups.

Thank you for joining us. Here is how the hunt works:

• Open Treasures and choose a treasure to find.
• Read the clue and hint to work out where on campus to go.
• Use the map and walk to the location that matches the clue.
• When you are close enough, a search area appears on the map. Move around inside it until the pin appears.
• Tap the pin to collect the treasure.
• Points are fixed by rarity: Common 10, Rare 25, Legendary 100. The confirmation dialog on the map shows how many points you will earn before you add the treasure to your collection. Each find is added to your running total.
• Your total score is shown on Stats. If you are signed in, it is kept in sync with the Leaderboard so you can see how you rank against other players.
• Open Stats at any time to view your badges and track your progress.
Tell us what went wrong or share an idea. Reports help the NTU Hunt team improve the app for everyone on campus.
Questions about your account or module work? Contact your school office or NTU Student Services.
